body.p: REGULATION (EEC) No 2988/74 OF THE COUNCIL

p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-top: 0pt

body.p: of 26 November 1974

p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-top: 0pt

body.p: concerning limitation periods in proceedings and the enforcement of sanctions under the rules of the European Economic Community relating to transport and competition

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN COMMUNITIES,

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Having regard to the Treaty establishing the European Economic Community, and in particular Articles 75, 79 and 87 thereof;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Having regard to the proposal from the Commission;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas under the rules of the European Economic Community relating to transport and competition the Commission has the power to impose fines, penalties and periodic penalty payments on undertakings or associations of undertakings which infringe Community law relating to information or investigation, or to the prohibition on discrimination, restrictive practices and abuse of dominant position; whereas those rules make no provision for any limitation period;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas it is necessary in the interests of legal certainty that the principle of limitation be introduced and that implementing rules be laid down; whereas, for the matter to be covered fully, it is necessary that provision for limitation be made not only as regards the power to impose fines or penalties, but also as regards the power to enforce decisions, imposing fines, penalties or periodic penalty payments; whereas such provisions should specify the length of limitation periods, the date on which time starts to run and the events which have the effect of interrupting or suspending the limitation period; whereas in this respect the interests of undertakings and associations of undertakings on the one hand, and the requirements imposed by administrative practice, on the other hand, should be taken into account;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt
font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 1

p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Limitation periods in proceedings

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 1. The power of the Commission to impose fines or penalties for infringements of the rules of the European Economic Community relating to transport or competition shall be subject to the following limitation periods:

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (a) three years in the case of infringements of provisions concerning applications or notifications of undertakings or associations of undertakings, requests for information, or the carrying out of investigations;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (b) five years in the case of all other infringements.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 2. Time shall begin to run upon the day on which the infringement is committed. However, in the case of continuing or repeated infringements, time shall begin to run on the day on which the infringement ceases.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 2

p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Interruption of the limitation period in proceedings

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 1. Any action taken by the Commission, or by any Member State, acting at the request of the Commission, for the purpose of the preliminary investigation or proceedings in respect of an infringement shall interrupt the limitation period in proceedings. The limitation period shall be interrupted with effect from the date on which the action is notified to at least one undertaking or association or undertakings which have participated in the infringement.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: Actions which interrupt the running of the period shall include in particular the following:

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (a) written requests for information by the Commission, or by the competent authority of a Member State acting at the request of the Commission; or a Commission decision requiring the requested information;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (b) written authorizations to carry out investigations issued to their officials by the Commission or by the competent authority of any Member State at the request of the Commission; or a Commission decision ordering an investigation;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (c) the commencement of proceedings by the Commission;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (d) notification of the Commission's statement of objections.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 2. The interruption of the limitation period shall apply for all the undertakings or associations of undertakings which have participated in the infringement.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 3. Each interruption shall start time running afresh. However, the limitation period shall expire at the latest on the day on which a period equal to twice the limitation period has elapsed without the Commission having imposed a fine or a penalty; that period shall be extended by the time during which limitation is suspended pursuant to Article 3.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 3

p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Suspension of the limitation period in proceedings

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: The limitation period in proceedings shall be suspended for as long as the decision of the Commission is the subject of proceedings pending before the Court of Justice of the European Communities.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 4

p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Limitation period for the enforcement of sanctions

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 1. The power of the Commission to enforce decisions imposing fines, penalties or periodic payments for infringements of the rules of the European Economic Community relating to transport or competition shall be subject to a limitation period of five years.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 2. Time shall begin to run on the day on which the decision becomes final.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 5

p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Interruption of the limitation period for the enforcement of sanctions

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 1. The limitation period for the enforcement of sanctions shall be interrupted:

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (a) by notification of a decision varying the original amount of the fine, penalty or periodic penalty payments or refusing an application for variation;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (b) by any action of the Commission, or of a Member State at the request of the Commission, for the purpose of enforcing payments of a fine, penalty or periodic penalty payment.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 2. Each interruption shall start time running afresh.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 6

p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Suspension of the limitation period for the enforcement of sanctions

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: The limitation period for the enforcement of sanctions shall be suspended for so long as:

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (a) time to pay is allowed; or

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (b) enforcement of payment is suspended pursuant to a decision of the Court of Justice of the European Communities.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 7

p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Application to transitional cases

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: This Regulation shall also apply in respect of infringements committed before it enters into force.

body.p: Article 8

p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Entry into force

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: This Regulation shall enter into force on 1 January 1975.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-top: 6pt

body.p: This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.
